0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Grizzlies hosting the Utah Jazz in Memphis. Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (out, ankle), while GG Jackson (ankle), Jerami Grant (rest), and Micah Peavy (ankle) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions; Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot) and Kyle Filipowski (day-to-day, back, game-time decision). The teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the most recent meeting came on April 10, 2026, when the Grizzlies lost 147-101 in Salt Lake City, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives Memphis a 45% chance to win.
